camel_example: aliyun oos ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceIds '["templateNam1","templateName2"]' --NextToken MTRBMDc0NjAtRUJFNy00N0NBLTk3NTctMTJDQzQ --ResourceType template --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Tags '{"k1":"v2","k2":"v2"}'
description_en: Queries the tags that are added to one or more resources
description_zh: 查询可见的资源标签关系
kebab_example: aliyun oos list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-ids '[templateNam1, templateName2]' --resource-type template --tags k1=v2 k2=v2 --next-token MTRBMDc0NjAtRUJFNy00N0NBLTk3NTctMTJDQzQ --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The IDs of resources. The number of resource IDs ranges from 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID，资源ID数量限制为1至50
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en: The type of the resource. Valid values: template execution
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型定义。取值范围：
template:OOS模版
execution:OOS执行
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The tag keys and values. The number of key-value pairs ranges from 1 to 20
parameters.help_zh: 标签键及值，键值对数量限制为1至20
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 查询返回结果承接上一页的Token，该参数需从上一页返回结果中获取
parameters.name: next_token

NextToken.description_en: The returned value of NextToken is a pagination token, which can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the return value of the NextToken parameter is empty, the next page does not exist
NextToken.description_zh: 再次查询时，若期望返回结果承接本页，则在请求参数中的NextToken传入该值。若NextToken对应返回值为空，则表示不存在下一页

TagResource.description_en: The set of resources and the tags that are added to the resources
